svg.text: true pixels at 1x (drawn at 2x): body 172 px high, 720 px wide. Left to right: patterns, loop display, tabs, section of 8 columns x 45 px
Tab L: loops (the pitch loop in one row, the four lanes below, the roll buttons in the last row)
Tab T: tone (base value and four lane amounts per parameter)
Always visible: 8 patterns, Off, Tune and Volume, and the display with the pitch loop and all four lanes. Every edit is audible at once. White marks the playing step.
Lane colours are placeholders for theme colours. Amounts are a share of the parameter range, zero amounts stay dim. Pitch is in Hz, never notes.
